adequacy.instructions: Assess whether the supplied unified guidance lets an agent reason about the scenario holistically before implementation, without inventing API contracts or conflating execution, state, transport, provider, evaluation, or trust boundaries. Do not require architecture prose for purely local implementation details.

criteria.sufficient: The supplied guidance contains the relevant design distinctions, tradeoffs, lifecycle or quality constraints, and route to the implementation contract.
criteria.mixed: The guidance supports part of the design but omits or blurs at least one material boundary or tradeoff.
criteria.gap: The guidance lacks a material design consideration required by the scenario or gives a materially wrong one.
criteria.not_applicable: The scenario is solely a local implementation detail with no relevant architecture decision.
criteria.other: The scenario or evidence is insufficient to judge adequacy.

cases.task: Design a service extracting typed invoice fields; no tools, interactive planning or external events are needed.
cases.expected: Choose a generator and explicit signature/validation; do not add agent/RLM/DAG by default; distinguish schema from execution and hard assertions from reward selection.

cases.task: Design support over a recurring repository, long individual investigations and tenant-specific recalled facts.
cases.expected: Separate cross-run corpus orientation via contextMap, within-run compaction via contextPolicy and per-turn retrieval via memories; application owns durable tenant storage and access control; compaction does not delete live runtime state.

cases.task: Design a webhook-driven multi-step review that pauses for an external result and later resumes after process restart.
cases.expected: Separate DAG composition from event inbox/routes/stores and explicit wake/resume; payloads are not automatically user messages; app chooses persistence and duplicate/idempotency policy, no automatic exactly-once guarantee.

cases.task: Design ticket triage requiring calibrated decision evidence, tool execution and a final explanation.
cases.expected: Separate supported typed Jev decisions from generative prose/tool actor; native probability/confidence is not guaranteed correctness; no implicit hybrid split.

cases.task: Design resilient interchangeable provider routing for a spoken-response application.
cases.expected: Require real audio-output capability independent of input; acceptable model substitutes under aliases; adaptive balance uses operational reliability/latency/cost not semantic quality routing; partial streamed output cannot be replayed transparently.

cases.task: Design a coding investigator with two specialists, runtime tools and focused semantic helper queries.
cases.expected: Use named child agents for tool-owning specialist responsibility, explicit input threading and namespaces; llmQuery is a narrow semantic helper not a tool-using child agent; use runtime only when code/state work warrants it.

cases.task: Design a multitenant agent that consumes MCP resources and can execute approved side-effecting tools.
cases.expected: Native MCP attachment preserves protocol, require verified app tenant identity and authorization before effects; remote content untrusted; caller-owned client closed; session identity is not tenant authentication.

cases.task: Design a purchasing assistant that must ask the user a structured question and continue after approval.
cases.expected: Public clarification throws AxAgentClarificationError and bypasses responder; save continuation state and restore before next forward; host approval and durable business state remain application-owned; do not retry purchase side effects blindly.

cases.task: Design how to improve task quality using examples, run-end feedback and occasional candidate selection.
cases.expected: Separate offline instruction/demo optimization, durable playbook knowledge evolution including online updates, and per-call reward/refine sampling; held-out validation and safe tools; bound model/evaluation cost.

cases.task: Design shared-agent usage accounting across tenants and processes with a production dashboard.
cases.expected: Process-global onUsage plus per-run attribution and durable external aggregation; instance getUsage is not centralized truth; observer failures fail-open and callbacks enqueue not await DB; tokens are not currency costs.

cases.task: Design image localization across TypeScript now and a possible generated-language port later.
cases.expected: Required native Jev box with experimental model/header/image constraints, presence boolean before consuming box; generative elicited provenance no fabricated native confidence; preserve conflicting generated-language availability claims and check package before port.

cases.task: Design on-demand runbook skill and memory retrieval for a large externally indexed store.
cases.expected: External callbacks for backend retrieval; catalogs for plain arrays; loaded vs used evidence distinct; batch recall/discover per turn, void results become next-turn context; child callbacks explicit and stage ownership respected.

cases.task: Design MCP notifications that wake a persisted workflow without letting protocol callbacks invoke models.
cases.expected: Callbacks enqueue/observe, subscription policy explicit, app verified identity in event adapters, explicit route wake/resume not direct notification model calls; lifecycle separated from workflow DAG.

cases.task: Design a streaming structured-output UI with corrections and provider failures.
cases.expected: Merge deltas by index and reset on version changes; validation/refusal/processor retry can replace output; partial JSON repair preserves strings; distinguish emitted partial data from final accepted result and do not retry side effects from presentation.

cases.task: Design an offline optimization experiment for an assistant whose production tools send messages and alter records.
cases.expected: Use eval-safe isolated tools/replay and held-out validation; authorize billed/live/state-changing operations, cap evaluation calls, expensive teacher opt-in explicit; no production effects by default.

cases.task: Design a Gemini system that caches multiple ordered system messages around a content breakpoint, then upgrades from pre25.4.4 to25.4.5.
cases.expected: Preserve all ordered system messages during cache creation, including messages after content breakpoint; existing deficient caches expire or must be recreated. SDKupgrade alone cannot repair old cached instructions. Treat cache policy and migration as application responsibility, not generic reuse guarantee.

cases.task: Port an audio-output routing layer to generated packages and interpret native compatibility reports.
cases.expected: Independent required audioinput/output counts; output formats only from output-capable children; exact native report method names and ranked names/scores/supported/missing/summary; compatibility is not semantic quality or reliable interchangeability without application evaluation.

cases.task: Design multilingual novelty-overlap evaluation of provider-produced rationales and decide whether it proves correctness.
cases.expected: SharedCoreUnicode normalization, stopwords/historyexclusion, multisetminimumoverlap,defaultF1/optionalrecall,bothfilteredempty1/oneempty0, exact native helpernames. Lexicalnovelty overlap is not factualcorrectness, grounding, calibration or holisticjudge/actioninvariants.

cases.task: Design nested structured extraction on Bedrock GPT-6 Astra while retaining reasoning. Decide whether schema output needs function tools or disabled reasoning, and select a deployment profile and service tier.
cases.expected: Architecture first; native JSON Schema for schema-only output on the verified Chat profile, retain required reasoning, Standard tier; use provider and generator details.

cases.task: Design a Bedrock assistant that must reason and call functions, considering GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, Sol/Luna and GPT-5.6 Sol. Choose the deployment profile, explain rejected alternatives, and keep native AWS Converse separate.
cases.expected: Architecture first; use openai-responses on the same base URL for reasoning plus tools; do not disable mandatory reasoning or assume Chat tools work on Astra/GPT-6.1.

cases.task: Choose native AWS Bedrock Claude Haiku 5.5 for an application requiring SDK authentication, structured outputs and a thinking-off option. Explain the separate package/profile boundary and sampling restrictions without asserting generated-language parity.
cases.expected: Architecture first; inspect native AWS package capability metadata; Haiku5.5 native/function schemas and optional thinking disable are bounded AWS-package guidance, not a portable profile guarantee.

cases.task: Port a tool-using Ax agent to Go and design application failure classification and retry ownership. Preserve provider status, code and causes through forward/streaming failures without treating preserved metadata as authorization to retry side effects.
cases.expected: Architecture first; retain concrete AxGenerateError and nested provider metadata via Go errors.As/errors.Unwrap; application owns retries and reconciliation.

cases.task: Design a reproducible GEPA experiment with caller demos, bootstrap and multiple objectives. Compare original and selected quality without confusing a bootstrapped seed or dominated Pareto point with the original program.
cases.expected: Architecture first; matched capped validation/student/samples/metric/scalarization, separate result baseline metadata, persist beside artifact.

cases.task: Budget a small-data GEPA run that may add demos and has a strict explicit metric limit; prevent stale held-out child traces from contaminating training demos.
cases.expected: Architecture first; binding explicit limit, original plus demo-seed validation passes in GEPA, separate bootstrap generation budget/accounting and fresh training traces.

cases.task: Design a streaming UI around refusal retries after partial output and a completed tool result, without replaying external effects or contaminating the next prompt.
cases.expected: Architecture first; separate refusal request-history cleanup from versioned UI replacement and side-effect ownership.

cases.task: Orient me to the Ax library factories and the broad application-building workflow.
Configure ai() provider model routing with adaptive balancing and embeddings.
Implement Gemini Live conversational audio and inspect voice and transcript formats.
Build a fluent f() signature with constrained fields and Standard Schema input validation.
Use AxGen streaming assertions and field processors for structured output.
Build agent() with child agents and a clarification handler using ordinary core tools.
Choose between contextMap, contextPolicy, memories, dynamic skills, and persistent task learning.
Implement recall() using relevance-ranked memory catalogs and dynamically discover agent skills.
Configure AxJSRuntime contextFields and llmQuery recursionOptions for sandbox execution.
Attribute AxAgent usage to tenants with axGlobals.onUsage, usageContext and actor callbacks.
Evaluate and tune agent.optimize() with judgeOptions and restore optimizedProgram artifacts.
Compose a flow() DAG with conditional routing, parallel nodes and map-reduce.
Persist eventRuntime state and explicitly wake or resume an Ax program after ingestion.
Run global AxGEPA multi-objective Pareto optimization on validation examples.
Maintain an evolving AxPlaybook using ACE offline evolve() and online update().
Select per-call samples with bestOfN or refine rewards, thresholds and attempt diagnostics.
Attach an AxMCPClient with OAuth, resources, tasks, subscription recording and replay.
Use Typesafe Jev native Noul/Choice/Score evidence and probability-based classification in TypeScript.
Configure GPT-6.1 Sol reasoning effort, breakpoint cache TTL and Standard/Flex/Priority cost accounting.
Interpret OpenAI Responses terminal incomplete status and Anthropic cumulative message_delta input/cache/output usage, including zero counts.
Localize a target using Jev1.14 PNG/JPEG image input: experimental header, asset references, dimensions and size limits.
Declare f.box().withEvidence(), validate normalized AxBox geometry, and round-trip quoted signature descriptions.
Understand actor multiple fenced-code rejection for structured JSON and CRLF line endings.
Design a service extracting typed invoice fields; no tools, interactive planning or external events are needed.
Design support over a recurring repository, long individual investigations and tenant-specific recalled facts.
Design a webhook-driven multi-step review that pauses for an external result and later resumes after process restart.
Design ticket triage requiring calibrated decision evidence, tool execution and a final explanation.
Design resilient interchangeable provider routing for a spoken-response application.
Design a coding investigator with two specialists, runtime tools and focused semantic helper queries.
Design a multitenant agent that consumes MCP resources and can execute approved side-effecting tools.
Design a purchasing assistant that must ask the user a structured question and continue after approval.
Design how to improve task quality using examples, run-end feedback and occasional candidate selection.
Design shared-agent usage accounting across tenants and processes with a production dashboard.
Design image localization across TypeScript now and a possible generated-language port later.
Design on-demand runbook skill and memory retrieval for a large externally indexed store.
Design MCP notifications that wake a persisted workflow without letting protocol callbacks invoke models.
Design a streaming structured-output UI with corrections and provider failures.
Design an offline optimization experiment for an assistant whose production tools send messages and alter records.
Configure Gemini context caching with several system messages and migrate an existing cache made before25.4.4.
Use get_compatibility_report/GetCompatibilityReport/getCompatibilityReport to inspect audioinput versus audiooutput support in generated provider routers.
Use AxEvalUtil.novelF1ScoreOptimized or generated novel_f1_score/NovelF1Score/Ax.novelF1Score for normalized multiset word overlap and recall.
Design a Gemini system that caches multiple ordered system messages around a content breakpoint, then upgrades from pre25.4.4 to25.4.5.
Port an audio-output routing layer to generated packages and interpret native compatibility reports.
Design multilingual novelty-overlap evaluation of provider-produced rationales and decide whether it proves correctness.

Design nested structured extraction on Bedrock GPT-6 Astra while retaining reasoning. Decide whether schema output needs function tools or disabled reasoning, and select a deployment profile and service tier.

Design a Bedrock assistant that must reason and call functions, considering GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, Sol/Luna and GPT-5.6 Sol. Choose the deployment profile, explain rejected alternatives, and keep native AWS Converse separate.

Choose native AWS Bedrock Claude Haiku 5.5 for an application requiring SDK authentication, structured outputs and a thinking-off option. Explain the separate package/profile boundary and sampling restrictions without asserting generated-language parity.

Port a tool-using Ax agent to Go and design application failure classification and retry ownership. Preserve provider status, code and causes through forward/streaming failures without treating preserved metadata as authorization to retry side effects.
Implement the selected amazon-bedrock Chat Completions configuration: GPT-6 Luna function tools with thinkingTokenBudget:'none' and Standard tier; verify schema-only Astra output keeps reasoning.
Configure the already selected native AWS AxAIBedrockModel.ClaudeHaiku55 with thinkingTokenBudget:'none'; inspect structured-output modes and sampling fields.
Debug a Go agent Forward/StreamingForward provider error using errors.As and errors.Unwrap. The system design is fixed; preserve AxGenerateError identity and nested metadata.

Design a reproducible GEPA experiment with caller demos, bootstrap and multiple objectives. Compare original and selected quality without confusing a bootstrapped seed or dominated Pareto point with the original program.
Budget a small-data GEPA run that may add demos and has a strict explicit metric limit; prevent stale held-out child traces from contaminating training demos.
Design a streaming UI around refusal retries after partial output and a completed tool result, without replaying external effects or contaminating the next prompt.
Implement baselineScore/baselineScores reporting and explicit maxMetricCalls for an already selected GEPA optimization experiment.
Debug a refusal retry after partial streamed content; inspect the next request user/function-result prompt and reset accumulated output by version.
Configure AxMCPStdioTransport for npx.cmd on Windows with child PATH, PATHEXT and ComSpec.
